finding.text: The report tab asks Servex over `/api/item` (AICost.js:154) rather than calling `Task.summary()` in the page. No number is copied by hand, which meets the brief. The tab is empty on a static copy of the site or a worktree preview, and it says so in words (AICost.js:157-163).

The wording of the counts is hard to follow (shots/2026_10_20_session-e00f55c9-1200.png, second line). It reads "30 of 91 tasks complete, 61 open — 73 stopped, left out of the count · 283 created in all, 82 complete", so 91, 283 and 82 sit side by side with no explanation. Law 2 asks for plain sentences, so say what each denominator counts.

Two numbers on the cost line read like a mistake. "The agents on its tasks cost $355.29 (counted inside the child sessions)" is larger than "child sessions $330.75". In the child-session table (AICost.js:214), "own" and "with its children" are not defined.
The costliest-tasks table has no header row (AICost.js:207), unlike the child-session table below it. The 64-row child-session table is unbounded and makes the report tab very long.

The 2026_10 shot at 400 shows the "no summary" text as "its sessions have no day summary yet; open it to see its tasks". The code at StoreFolder.js:101 says "no summary has been rolled up for it yet". The shots were taken before the final wording, or from different code, so re-shoot. The date link also wraps to "2026-/10-23" at 400.

The diff is mostly generated `files.jsonl` churn, 30 or more files with `gone:true` lines. It is harmless but noisy. Landing only AICost.js, AITask.js and StoreFolder.js would keep the merge clean. The `"No cost line…"` change at AICost.js:114 drops the explanation that tabs and CLI sessions never get a cost line.

Requirement 1 is met in the shot ($572.27 total with its own and child split, child sessions with states, counts, and no dashes). Requirement 2 is met: the year and month pages list sessions with counts and cost. The 12 shots (four widths for each of three pages) are present and named after the pages.
